statements.status_notes: pip 26.1.2 fixes this CVE, but pip is a transitive dependency from the dhi/ceph artifact that rook-ceph includes. Upgrading pip in place within the rook-ceph image would be risky and could break Ceph Python dependencies. The fix should be applied in the dhi/ceph image, which will then propagate to rook-ceph through the artifact tracking mechanism.
